"### Chart Description: Monetary Financing

This chart tracks cumulative Monetary Financing in Argentina from January 2023 through mid-2024. 

*   **Title:** Monetary Financing
*   **Units:** Billions of AR$ (Argentine Pesos), representing a cumulative ceiling since the start of the year.
*   **Legend:**
    *   **Light Blue Line:** Actual
    *   **Dark Blue Line:** Target (7th review)

#### Axes
*   **X-Axis (Time):** Monthly intervals from Jan-23 to Jul-24.
*   **Y-Axis (Value):** Values in Billions of AR$, ranging from -4200 to 3800 in increments of 1000.

#### Data Trends
The chart shows two distinct cumulative periods (2023 and 2024), as the metric resets at the beginning of each year.

**1. Calendar Year 2023**
In 2023, both the target and actual values remained in positive territory, generally increasing in a step-like fashion until late Q3.

| Date Period (Approx.) | Target (Billions of AR$) | Actual (Billions of AR$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Jan-23 to Mar-23 | ~100 | ~0 |
| Mar-23 to May-23 | ~400 | ~150 - 400 |
| May-23 to Jul-23 | ~400 | ~700 |
| Jul-23 to Sep-23 | ~1700 | ~1900 |
| Sep-23 to Jan-24 | ~1300 - 1700 | ~1400 |

**2. Calendar Year 2024**
In 2024, the target was set and maintained at zero. The actual figures moved significantly into negative territory (net contraction).

| Date Period (Approx.) | Target (Billions of AR$) | Actual (Billions of AR$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Jan-24 onwards | 0 | Starts near -2400 |
| Feb-24 to Mar-24 | 0 | Volatile, peaking near -400 |
| Mar-24 (Low point) | 0 | Sharp drop to approx. -3900 |
| Apr-24 to Jul-24 | 0 | Stabilizes near -2100 |

---
*Note: The second image provided contains background/non-chart information which was not used for this description per the instructions.*"
